motionArtifact.name: Arial

usage: Keep this file beside DESIGN.md, tokens.json, variables.css, and theme.css.
Use letterSpacing.default (-0.02em) as the inherited slide default; use letterSpacing.none only for elements that need neutral tracking.
For rendered Korean slide decks, use Paperlogy unless the active design set explicitly requires another font.
